title: EdiMarkWeb: Markdown text editor
desktop_window_btn_title: Open in a standalone window, with no tabs or address bar
doc_lang_btn_title: Language, author, contents and formatting of this document.
doc_settings_modal_description: Settings remembered from one session to the next. If your document starts with its own YAML metadata, that wins.
doc_settings_language_hint: Marks the language in all five formats: spell checking in DOCX and ODT, hyphenation in LaTeX and the language attribute in HTML and EPUB.
doc_settings_author_hint: Stored in the file properties, and shown in the EPUB and on the LaTeX title page. In DOCX and ODT a line with the name is also written at the start of the document. Leave it empty for no author.
doc_settings_toc_hint: Adds a table of contents at the start of the document, with the sections. In DOCX and ODT it is written ready to read, but without page numbers: to get those, refresh it in your program (in Word, right-click it → Update field; in LibreOffice, Tools → Update → Indexes). The EPUB does not need it: the reader already has its own.
doc_settings_numbering_hint: Numbers the headings (1, 1.1, 1.2…). ODT does not support this numbering and comes out without it.
doc_settings_cover_hint: The image shown on the shelf of the e-book reader. It only affects the EPUB.
doc_settings_cover_auto: Generated from the title and the author
doc_settings_cover_too_big: The image takes {size} and the limit is 1 MB. Try a smaller one.
doc_settings_cover_error: The image could not be read.
doc_settings_latex_section_hint: Applies when exporting to TEX and when copying LaTeX as a full document.
latex_settings_preamble_hint: Inserted verbatim at the end of the preamble. If it contains errors, the document will fail to compile.
menu_hint_import: From DOCX, ODT, EPUB, HTML or TEX
menu_hint_save_as: Under another name or in another folder
menu_hint_quit: Saves the document and closes the application
menu_hint_spellcheck: Underlines mistakes using the system dictionaries
menu_hint_export_options: Language, author, cover, contents and formatting of what you generate
menu_hint_manual: Everything the application does, with examples
menu_hint_updates: Checks whether a newer version is available
menu_hint_theme_system: Follows the computer's and changes with it
export_menu_hint_html: Self-contained web page, with its styles
desktop_banner_message: EdiMarkWeb Desktop {version} is available for Linux, Windows and macOS.
update_manual_download_message: EdiMarkWeb {version} is available, but there is no installer for this system. Download it from the release page.
update_up_to_date: You already have the latest version ({version}).
update_ready_installer: The installer is now open. Close EdiMarkWeb so it can replace the files, and open it again when it finishes.
update_ready_appimage: Downloaded to {path}. Close EdiMarkWeb and replace your AppImage with this file.
no_content: There is no content to export.
images_not_embedded: Some images could not be downloaded and were left out of the exported document.
images_too_large: Some images are too large to embed and have been left out of the exported document. Their alt text has been kept.
ios_specific_advice: On iOS, if the issue persists, close and restart the browser.
formula_hint_block_dollar: Block, on a line of its own
edicuatex_popup_blocked: Allow pop-ups in your browser to use EdiCuaTeX.
desktop_window_popup_blocked: Allow pop-ups in your browser to open the standalone window.
preview_zoom_out_title: Zoom the page out (Ctrl+-); the document does not change
preview_zoom_in_title: Zoom the page in (Ctrl++); the document does not change
copy_chord_hint: Copy: 1 Markdown · 2 HTML · 3 LaTeX · 4 full LaTeX · Esc cancels
copy_menu_markdown_hint: The source text, exactly as it stands in the editor
copy_menu_latex_hint: Just the fragment, to paste inside another document
copy_menu_latex_full_hint: With preamble and environment, ready to compile
copy_menu_html_hint: Pastes with formatting into word processors and editors
math_placement_block: As a block, on its own
math_preview_empty: Type the formula to see it here.
image_file_error: The selected image could not be read.
latex_import_modal_description: Paste a full LaTeX document. It will be converted to Markdown and replace the current content. Support is basic: advanced commands or external file references might be skipped.
import_file_error: The file could not be imported.
import_file_unsupported: File format not supported for import.
drop_title: Drop here to open in a new tab
drop_subtitle: Markdown (.md, .markdown) or DOCX, ODT, EPUB, HTML and TEX documents. You can also drop several files or whole folders.
drop_unsupported: You can only drop Markdown files (.md, .markdown) or DOCX, ODT, EPUB, HTML and TEX documents.
footer_privacy_notice: Files are processed locally in this browser. Only in-house aggregated usage statistics are collected, and no files or data are sent to third parties.
footer_privacy_notice_desktop: Files are processed locally on your computer. The app collects no usage statistics and sends no files or data to third parties.
storage_unavailable: Local storage is unavailable. Changes will not be retained after you close the application.
storage_quota_exceeded: Local storage is full. Save the document to a file to avoid losing your changes.
storage_corrupt_recovered: The saved document list was damaged. A new session has been started so you can keep working.
base64_hidden_hint: The code is hidden to make editing easier.
base64_extract_btn: Move the images to the folder
base64_extract_btn_title: Writes each image as a file in the document folder and leaves its path in the text
base64_extract_done_one: {count} image moved to “{folder}”. It will be written when you save the document.
base64_extract_done_many: {count} images moved to “{folder}”. They will be written when you save the document.
base64_extract_empty: There are no embedded images in this document.
base64_extract_error: The images could not be moved to the folder.
base64_delete_confirm: Remove “{name}” from the document? This cannot be undone.
base64_view_code_hint: Copy the image code to paste it into another document.
base64_modal_description: The fragment remains hidden in the editor to save space. You can view or copy it here.
clipboard_button_unsupported: Your browser cannot read the clipboard from a button. Use Ctrl+V.
clipboard_read_error: The clipboard could not be read. Use Ctrl+V instead.
clipboard_empty_or_unsupported: The clipboard is empty or uses an unsupported format.
save_file_bundle_done: Document and images saved in {name}; extract it to preserve their folders.
save_file_error: The document could not be saved.
open_file_error: The document could not be opened.
missing_assets_one: One image in this document cannot be found.
missing_assets_many: {count} images in this document cannot be found.
image_insert_mode_relative_help: The image stays in its folder and the document just names it. The text stays small and the image can be replaced without touching it.
image_insert_mode_embedded_help: The image travels embedded in the file itself, which becomes self-contained but much heavier.
image_insert_mode_url_help: The document points to an image that lives online: it takes up no space, but it stops showing if that address changes or there is no connection.
image_insert_mode_unsaved_warning: This document has not been saved yet, so there is no folder to work the path out from: only the file name will be written. Save it next to the image or embed the image instead.
image_insert_mode_browser_warning: In the browser the image folder is unknown: only its name will be written, and the document will find it if both sit side by side.
image_insert_mode_outside_warning: The image is outside the document folder: the path climbs with “../” and will only work if both are moved together.
doc_format_modal_hint: Saved inside the document itself, so it travels with the file. Anything left on “Inherited” follows the export options.
doc_format_inherited_hint: Under each empty field you can see the value it inherits right now.
doc_own_outline_hint: The table of contents goes at the start of the exported document; the EPUB does not need one, because the reader already has its own. ODT does not support section numbering.
doc_settings_format_section_hint: Starting values for every document. Each document can set its own from the Markdown pane.
doc_format_status_hint: This is how it will export or print. Click to change it.
doc_format_font_custom_hint: The suggestions are the installed typefaces that could be recognised.
doc_format_font_system_btn: Show every typeface on this computer…
doc_format_font_system_ready: Every typeface on this computer is now suggested.
doc_format_font_system_denied: The system list could not be read; type the name by hand.
doc_format_font_missing: “{font}” does not seem to be installed here: the document keeps it anyway and it will look right on a computer that has it; here it falls back to another typeface.
doc_format_hyphenate_hint: Hyphenation uses the system dictionaries: on Linux, LibreOffice needs the language package (hyphen-en, for instance).
latex_margins_dropped: The preamble already loads geometry, so the margins from the document formatting were not applied to the TEX file.
